cause_quote: The diff added `setActiveEmbeddedRun(params.sessionId, cliOwner, params.sessionKey, params.sessionFile)` with a new `cliOwner` that supplied `runId: params.runId` but omitted `startedAtMs`.
user_saw: The Control UI’s Working timer restarted near zero when a user reopened a session while Claude CLI was still running.
summary: The fix records the logical turn’s start time when the lifecycle manager is created and passes it through the CLI run owner to chat history.
reasoning: I checked that #119729 added timer restoration for chat-owned runs and that #123189 extended history recovery to read `startedAtMs` from registered run owners. The parent of #126566 entered the CLI execution branch without registering a handoff owner, and #126566 introduced that owner without a timestamp, so its history snapshot lacked the real start time from the first release of that path.
